messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English between two adult friends who are attracted to each other but have not openly talked about it. Let the attraction come through in dialogue, pauses, small physical reactions, and what they avoid saying. Do not have either character directly explain all of their feelings. Keep the scene grounded, contemporary, and subtle. Avoid melodrama and clichés. Output only the story prose.

“You're staring again.”

Alex looked away from Jordan's face. “I wasn't.”

“You were.”

“I was thinking.”

“About?”

Alex shrugged. “Nothing important.”

Jordan smiled a little. “That's usually what you say when it is.”

They were sitting close enough that their knees touched whenever either of them moved. Neither had bothered to fix it.

Jordan picked up her drink. “You nervous?”

“No.”

“You're doing the straw thing.”

Alex glanced down. She hadn't realized she was twisting it between her fingers.

“I do that all the time.”

“Not like that.”

Alex laughed under her breath. “You notice too much.”

“I notice you.”

The words came out quietly.

Alex looked at her.

Jordan seemed to realize what she'd said at exactly the same moment. She cleared her throat and reached for the napkin on the table.

“I mean, you're usually pretty easy to read.”

“Right.”

“Right.”

A silence settled between them.

Alex smiled. “You know, you're not very convincing.”

Jordan shook her head. “I know.”

Neither of them moved their knees.”
